svg.aria-label: Standard profile: the new loop with fairways, one captain per fairway on a deck log under a harbourmaster
svg.text: ONCE PER FEATURE · host session, a person present · the chart is written before any slice is claimed
marks set + steered by, per slice
owned paths · marks set · steered by
written here, the plan repeats it
PER FAIRWAY · one captain, one berth (worktree, env, ports, database), one deck log · the same loop runs in every other fairway, within the telegraph's position
CAPTAIN · the outer loop for this fairway
at every stage boundary, enforced by the captain: inbox read + receipt · heartbeat · stage budget · token budget · controls guard · stop file
the slice's shape, not a cycle's
ONE SLICE · drive-slice delegate in its own worktree · stages strictly sequential inside
runs the ladder, inside those controls
merged → the captain takes the next cleared slice
every steered-by mark has a setter
GATES · on the slice branch, and what each one reads
mark set → harbourmaster copies it to the harbour log → other fairways re-derive clearance
HARBOUR · what every fairway touches, the harbourmaster, and a person
main · a merge is as dark as the release mode says · first come across fairways, split order within · composition root rendered from the chart
Two fairways never meet on one line: one file per event, per-fairway logs, ids with the fairway in them. A real conflict in a mark stops both for the host
only writer of the harbour log
pressure gauge · bunker · banks the fires
